name: The White Castle Duel

categories.label: Clan Points from red fans
categories.hint: Clan Points scored on the track during the game.

categories.label: Coins and Daimyo Seals
categories.hint: 1 Clan Point per 5 coins and/or Daimyo Seals combined (round down).

categories.label: Remaining resources
categories.hint: Per resource type: 3-6 units = 1 pt, 7 units = 2 pts.

categories.label: Nobori flags
categories.hint: Nobori flag icons x castle level reached by your Courtier (1, 2 or 3).

categories.label: Katanas
categories.hint: Katana icons x Clan Seals in the Basic Training Yard.

categories.label: Kabutos
categories.hint: Kabuto icons x (Clan Seals in Basic Yard + 2 per Clan Seal in Elite Yard).

categories.label: Clan Seals placed
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: more Clan Seals placed wins.

categories.label: Social Climbing path position
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: higher on the path wins.

tiebreakers.description: Higher on the Social Climbing path
If still tied, the players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Final scoring after the last Lantern token is taken and the last player's turn ends (Return Round). Only icons from activated cards count (garden tiles/icons are automatic). Resource types assumed as rice, iron, pearl (matching the rulebook's shown icons and example). Seal counts for katana/kabuto are entered per card-set via the shared inputs of each category.
